description: Source code implementing utility functions for Bluetooth controller, including bit counting, access address generation, and ISO address manipulation.

methods.name: util_ones_count_get
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in a byte array.

methods.name: util_aa_le32
methods.description: Generates a valid Bluetooth access address according to specifications.

methods.name: util_saa_le32
methods.description: Calculates a specialized address for ISO transmissions based on a base address and handle.

methods.name: util_bis_aa_le32
methods.description: Generates a BIS-specific address based on a given BIS number, base address, and outputs to destination.
